Skips assets exceeding max_asset_size limit

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "crawlberg"
engine_config = { 'download_assets' => true, 'max_asset_size' => 150 }
engine = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config.to_json)
url = 'https://example.com'
result = Crawlberg.scrape(engine, url)
puts result.inspect
```
